## v2.1.2

JellyPilot 2.1.2 ships the pinned mpv fork with Linux packages and starts Embedded MPV Playback by default on Linux.

### Highlights
- Linux packages install the host-enabled libmpv and baseline at `/usr/lib/jellypilot/libmpv.so` and `/usr/share/jellypilot/mpv-baseline.conf`. A packaged `/usr/bin/jellypilot` loads those files; system libmpv is not used.
- Linux defaults to Embedded MPV Playback. Existing settings that still recorded External migrate once; an explicit External choice after that is kept. Windows and macOS stay on External.
- Missing Vulkan or pinned host assets is an error, not a fallback to system libmpv or an external player.

### Fixes
- Packaged binaries resolve embedded assets from the executable prefix (`../lib`, `../share`), so `/usr/bin/jellypilot` no longer looks under `/usr/bin/lib`.
